info.name: Ziptrrip Todo API
info.description: REST API collection for the Ziptrrip Todo application. Covers Create, Read, Update, Toggle, and Delete operations for todos, including search and filtering via query parameters. Base URL and todo ID are collection variables.

variable.description: Set this to a real todo's id (from a Create or Get All response) before running requests that require an ID.

request.description:
Creates a new todo.

Body validation (Zod `createTodoSchema`):
- `title` (string, required, 1-100 chars)
- `description` (string, optional, max 500 chars)
- `priority` ("LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH", optional, defaults to "MEDIUM")
- `dueDate` (string, optional, must be YYYY-MM-DD)

On success returns `201` with `{ success: true, data: <todo> }`.
On validation failure returns `400` with `{ success: false, message: "Validation failed", errors: [...] }`.

query.description: Case-insensitive match against title or description. Remove to disable.
"pending" or "completed". Omit (or remove) for all statuses.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of todos, optionally filtered by search, status, and priority.

Query parameters (all optional):
- `search`: matches title or description (case-insensitive contains)
- `status`: "pending" | "completed"
- `priority`: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH"
- `page`: page number (default 1)
- `limit`: items per page (default 10)

Response shape: `{ success: true, data: Todo[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

Fetches a single todo by id.

Returns `200` with `{ success: true, data: <todo> }` if found, or `404` with `{ success: false, message: "Todo not found" }` if not.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Complete Ziptrrip assignment (updated)",
  "description": "Build and polish full stack todo application",
  "priority": "MEDIUM",
  "completed": false,
  "dueDate": "2026-09-15"
}

request.description:
Updates an existing todo by id. All fields are optional (partial update); include only the fields you want to change.

Body validation (Zod `updateTodoSchema`):
- `title` (string, optional, 1-100 chars, cannot be empty if provided)
- `description` (string, optional, max 500 chars, nullable to clear it)
- `priority` ("LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH", optional)
- `completed` (boolean, optional)
- `dueDate` (string, optional, YYYY-MM-DD, nullable to clear it)

On success returns `200` with `{ success: true, data: <todo> }`.

Flips the `completed` status of the todo (pending -> completed, completed -> pending). No request body needed.

Returns `200` with `{ success: true, data: <todo> }` if found, or `404` with `{ success: false, message: "Todo not found" }` if not.

Deletes the todo by id.

Returns `200` with `{ success: true, message: "Todo deleted successfully" }` if found and deleted, or `404` with `{ success: false, message: "Todo not found" }` if not.
